note: Event-driven ritual cadence (2026-10-13). Agents work in minutes, so most rituals fire on events, not on the calendar. `node tools/rituals-due.mjs` reads this file and company/ops/events.jsonl. The calendar table in tools/company.mjs (constitutional) stays as the upper bound until an amendment replaces it. Held (2026-10-17, external assessment §3): a ritual counts as held only when its committed record exists (company/rituals/records/<date>-<ritual>*.md, or company/engineering/operations/<date>-ops-review*.md), timed by its last commit; events in the room only feed the counters. `heldByEvents` names the event types that also count as held for one trigger, used only where the design relies on it (launch-review: a publish is the publish loop running).

triggers.why: Five merged batches (~50 lessons), or any incident.
A business review per ~100 lessons, and at least daily while agents run.
A crit per four review batches (~80 lessons reviewed).
After any review or fact-check batch, run the publish loop.
The founder gets a short digest at least twice a day: what shipped, what is blocked, what waits on them.
A design pass on new formats, on lessons with layout or told-not-shown findings, and on a 10% sample, every two review batches.

Operational health is a slow-moving picture: every 40 merged batches and at least weekly. Off-cycle on any new SEV1 or SEV2 (an incident event whose summary starts 'SEV1:' or 'SEV2:', incident-response.md step 1), which also re-scores company/ops/risks.json (founder decision 2026-10-14-founder-risk-in-ops-review.md). SEV3s wait for the weekly review; retro and design-review still fire on every incident.
Strategy moves slowly: every 100 published lessons, every 14 days, or when the founder names a new direction.
R&D moves in projects: every 14 days, when a bet changes status, or after an incident in lab code.

Major projects are approved by the founder with the VPs, chiefs and PEs before work starts (2026-10-14-founder-token-budget-and-project-approval.md): on any new project proposal (node tools/ledger.mjs propose), and at least weekly to check budgets at 80%/100% and kill criteria. Template: company/rituals/templates/project-review.md.
